identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Support canonical PRs closing preserved legacy issues

values.goal: Harden and prove canonical code-repository PR publication against a separately identified preserved issue repository.
values.required_outcome: Typed publication and finish preserve exact code and issue repository identities, reject substitution, remain backward compatible, and retain a live split-authority canary.
declared_scope: C-SDLC v2 publication remote and PR reconciliation
Public schemas and typed operator documentation
Existing canonical PR #5 to legacy issue #5901 canary evidence
authority_boundary: Issue #3 owns only the declared C-SDLC v2 publication hardening and proof surfaces
The preserved legacy repository is read-only except for GitHub's closing relation caused by the canonical PR
Already-merged #5901 implementation is baseline evidence, not work to duplicate
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue changes on main
Use only typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle tools
Do not use AWS or remote builders
Do not merge without explicit operator authorization
